column3: Supplications is plural; faithfulness accompanies the request for an answer.
The spirit’s fainting is expressed as having occurred.
Remembering and meditating are expressed as completed actions before the final meditation.
I have spread out my hands is completed; thirsts is not a separate verb in the comparison.
I have lifted up my soul is expressed as a completed action.
The final image is covering or hiding oneself toward You, rather than explicitly fleeing.
The image includes a land of level ground.
The verbs describe what You will do rather than separate imperative forms.
The statements continue with what You will do, rather than separate imperative forms.
